title: About Us
metaDescription: Our story, values, and team — a design-led furniture and home décor destination.

hero.title: Crafting spaces that feel like home
hero.subtitle: We curate furniture, rugs, and lighting with timeless design, honest materials, and a deep respect for the way people live.

story.heading: Our story
story.lead: Diba Gallery began with a simple belief: every home deserves pieces that are beautiful, durable, and made with care.
paragraphs: What started as a small showroom has grown into a destination for design-led living — from handcrafted sofas and artisan rugs to statement lighting and finishing touches that complete a room.
We partner with makers who share our standards for quality and sustainability. Every collection is chosen for how it looks, how it feels, and how it lasts — season after season.

items.title: Thoughtful quality
items.description: Materials and construction chosen for longevity — not trends that fade in a season.

items.title: Design for living
items.description: Collections that balance aesthetics with comfort, scale, and everyday practicality.

items.title: Responsible sourcing
items.description: Partnerships with makers who prioritise ethical production and lower-impact materials.

items.title: Personal service
items.description: Free design consultations and delivery guidance from people who know the product inside out.

items.text: First showroom opens, focused on curated living-room collections.
Design services launch — free in-home and virtual consultations.
National delivery network expands; rug and lighting categories added.
Trade programme opens for interior designers and commercial projects.
Twelve studios nationwide, serving over fifty thousand homes.
